payload.title: File:Platecarpus Size.svg
payload.description_html:
Size comparison of Platecarpus tympanicus, based on LACM 128319. The diver silhoutte is from File:Scuba33.jpg, which is by NOAA, and in the public domain.

References

  • Lindgren, Johan; Caldwell, Michael W.; Konishi, Takuya; Chiappe Luis M.; (2010). "Convergent evolution in aquatic tetrapods: Insights from an exceptional fossil mosasaur". PLoS ONE 5 (8): e11998. DOI:10.1371/journal.pone.0011998.g008.
  • Konishi, Takuya; Lindgren, Johan; Caldwell, Michael W.; Chiappe, Luis (2012). "Platecarpus tympaniticus (Squamata, Mosasauridae): Osteology of an exceptionally preserved specimen and its insights into the acquisition of a streamlined body shape in mosasaurs". Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology 32 (6): 1313-1327.
